We are seeking an experienced Senior Mechanical Engineer specializing in marine and ports operations to join our organization in Kuwait City, Kuwait. In this pivotal role, you will lead the design, development, and optimization of mechanical systems and equipment critical to our port operations. You will work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to ensure all mechanical systems meet international standards, regulatory requirements, and operational excellence. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong technical expertise, analytical capabilities, and the ability to manage complex engineering projects from conception through implementation.
Design, analyze, and optimize mechanical systems and equipment for marine and port applications using advanced CAD software and modeling tools
Lead the development of technical specifications, engineering drawings, and comprehensive documentation for equipment installation and maintenance
Conduct detailed failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA) to identify potential system failures and implement preventive solutions
Oversee equipment procurement, vendor management, and quality assurance processes to ensure compliance with industry standards and specifications
Manage mechanical engineering projects from initial concept through commissioning, ensuring adherence to timelines, budgets, and performance metrics
Supervise and mentor junior engineering staff, providing technical guidance and fostering professional development within the team
Perform root cause analysis on equipment failures and develop corrective action plans to enhance system reliability and operational efficiency
Collaborate with operations and maintenance teams to troubleshoot mechanical issues and implement sustainable solutions
Ensure all mechanical systems and designs comply with international maritime regulations, safety protocols, and local regulatory requirements
Prepare and present technical reports, project updates, and performance metrics to senior management and stakeholders
Stay current with industry advancements, emerging technologies, and best practices in marine and port engineering
q: Minimum 10 years of professional experience in mechanical engineering with at least 5 years in marine and ports industry
Proven expertise in mechanical design, CAD software (AutoCAD, CATIA, or equivalent), and 3D modeling
Strong knowledge of hydraulic and pneumatic systems, equipment reliability, and maintenance protocols
Demonstrated experience in project management, including budget oversight and resource allocation
Proficiency in technical documentation, engineering standards, and regulatory compliance requirements
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to optimize complex mechanical systems
Leadership experience with the ability to manage and develop engineering teams effectively
Strong organizational and time management skills with meticulous attention to detail

ISO 9001, ISO 14001, or other relevant quality and environmental certifications (preferred)
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; additional language proficiency is advantageous
